header.title: Apply to work with us.
header.subtitle: We work with a limited number of clients per year. Tell us your challenge: we read it personally and respond within 3 business days.

form.name: Name
form.challengeHint: What you're trying to solve, where it stalled, and what would change if it worked.
form.confirmation: Your application is ready in your email: review it and send it from your email client.
form.note: We don't use automated forms or keyword filters: your application is read by a person, not a bot.

review.title: Review
review.text: We read your application and validate that we can truly contribute to your challenge.

conversation.title: Conversation
conversation.text: A 30-minute call about your challenge, its constraints and the expected result.

proposal.title: Proposal
proposal.text: A concrete plan: scope, assigned team and the target metric of the engagement.
